art_note: Clean studio cutout shots of the garment, but lacks editorial model imagery to meet true luxury standards.
desc_en: An essential layering piece for colder weather. This lightweight puffer vest features a sleeveless silhouette and a high collar. The full zip closure ensures adjustable coverage. It includes two front pockets and elastic cuffs for added comfort. Crafted from polyester with thermal insulation. Each piece is made to order with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Una prenda esencial para la temporada de frío. Este chaleco acolchado ligero ofrece una silueta sin mangas y un diseño de cuello alto. El cierre de cremallera completa asegura una cobertura ajustable. Cuenta con dos bolsillos frontales y puños elásticos para mayor comodidad. Confeccionado en poliéster con aislamiento térmico. Cada pieza se elabora bajo pedido con envíos a todo el mundo.
details_en:
· Composition: high-quality polyester

· Elastic cuffs
· Machine washable in cold water (maximum 40 ℃ or 104 ℉)
· Do not tumble dry, do not expose to the sun, do not bleach
